summary: Two critical blocker issues found: (1) 300x600 format shows unreadable/unverifiable logo—appears missing or severely degraded in initial state, and logo scaling is inconsistent between formats; (2) 320x480 format has a minor CTA spacing issue (small gap visible but acceptable). Additional warnings for typography hierarchy refinement and fine-print legibility. All IAB dimensions are correct; color palette and French copy are sound.

findings.issue: Logo is not clearly visible or readable in the initial state (300x600__initial.png); logo appears missing or severely degraded compared to 320x480 format.
findings.fix_hint: Ensure #ad-300x600 .logo-wrapper img has appropriate max-height (suggest ~40–50px) and is positioned with visible top/side margin; verify src path is correct and SVG loads without distortion.

findings.issue: Logo scaling and positioning inconsistency between 300x600 and 320x480; 300x600 logo appears much smaller and harder to identify as IKEA brand.
findings.fix_hint: Set consistent logo max-height across both formats (e.g. 45px for both), and ensure padding/margin around logo is proportional to frame size; use CSS to match visual hierarchy.

findings.issue: CTA button 'Découvrir la série' sits very close to the bottom edge of the ad frame in animated/settled states; minimal visible padding below the button.
findings.fix_hint: Add margin-bottom: 12px to the CTA button selector (e.g. #ad-320x480 .cta-button) to ensure visible breathing room above the frame bottom edge.

findings.issue: Legal text ('Prix valables en France métropolitaine') is quite small and may be difficult to read at small screen sizes; fine-print contrast could be stronger.
findings.fix_hint: Increase font-size to 11–12px (currently appears ~10px) and ensure #333 or darker text on light background; review line-height for legibility.

findings.issue: Product headline 'SÖDERHAMN' and subheading could benefit from tighter leading and more prominent visual separation from body copy.
findings.fix_hint: Add margin-top: 16px to .headline in #ad-320x480 and ensure line-height: 1.2 on the product title for tighter, more impactful display.
